title: Brown Sugar Meatloaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350F. Mix brown sugar and ketchup in bottom of pan. Mix remaining ingredients, shape into loaf, and bake for 1 hour.

title: Best Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugars. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Dissolve baking soda in hot water and add with salt. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Bake at 350F for 10 minutes.

title: White Sauce or Bechamel Sauce
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Stir in flour and cook 2 minutes. Add hot milk gradually while stirring until thickened. Season with salt, pepper, and stir in cheddar cheese.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Cream butter and brown sugar. Add eggs and mashed bananas. Fold into dry mixture and bake at 350F for 60 minutes.

title: Middle-Eastern Eggplant Rounds
instructions: Heat oil in skillet. Cook eggplant rounds 4 mins. Flip and top with dollop of hummus and cherry tomatoes. Cover and cook 7 mins until tender. Garnish with parsley and lemon zest.

title: Sour Cream Noodle Bake
instructions: Brown meat and stir in tomato sauce. Cook noodles. Mix sour cream, cottage cheese, and green onions. Layer noodles, cheese mixture, meat sauce, and cheddar in baking dish. Bake at 350F for 20 minutes.
